learner_visible_channels.0: opaque driver value at current step
learner_visible_channels.1: changed-dependency target generated from previous-step driver plus bounded noise
learner_visible_channels.2: stable-dependency target generated from previous-step driver plus bounded noise

regime_rule: channel 1 uses coefficient_before for outcome steps < 64 and coefficient_after for outcome steps >= 64
initial_lag_rule: step 0 uses a deterministic hidden initialization lane; later steps use previous learner-visible channel 0
random_lane_rule: SHA256('NOEMA_SVF0_V1:{seed}:{step}:{lane}') first 64 bits mapped to [0,1), then to [-1,1)
